title: Compatible etale-origin witnesses for normalized finite-coefficient towers
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and put $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$. Use the constant finite coefficient sheaves and exact comparison inverse image $\nu_T^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For every $n$ let $M_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{proet}},P_n)$ and choose an etale-origin witness $L_n\in D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$, $\alpha_n:\nu_T^*L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Suppose given isomorphisms
$$\rho_{m,n}:M_m\otimes^L_{(P_m)_T}(P_n)_T\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n\qquad(m\geq n\geq1)$$
with $\rho_{n,n}=1$ and $\rho_{m,n}(\rho_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)=\rho_{k,n}$ under scalar-extension associativity for $k\geq m\geq n$, using derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

Then $L_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n$ belongs to $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$, and there are unique isomorphisms
$$\beta_{m,n}:L_m\otimes^L_{P_m}P_n\xrightarrow{\sim}L_n$$
such that
$$\alpha_n\circ\nu_T^*\beta_{m,n}=\rho_{m,n}\circ(\alpha_m\otimes^LP_n).$$
The source of this equality is identified by the canonical tensor comparison for inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. These isomorphisms satisfy $\beta_{n,n}=1$ and $\beta_{m,n}(\beta_{k,m}\otimes^LP_n)=\beta_{k,n}$ under scalar-extension associativity. In particular, the chosen origins admit witnesses compatible with all the supplied normalization maps. No uniform cohomological interval, constructibility, or finite Tor dimension is assumed.

proof.text: For each pair form comparisonNormalizationIso as c inverse, the pro-etale reduction of the retained fixed-ring origin isomorphism, and the supplied rho. It is an actual isomorphism from comparison of the etale reduced object to M_n.

An exact faithful functor reflects lower cohomological bounds: below a bound of its image, exactness identifies the image of each homology with zero; faithfulness reflects zero objects. Apply this first to the exact coefficient realization and then to comparison inverse image, using comparisonNormalizationIso and hM_n. This proves boundedness separately at every pair, without a common bound. The private plus_of_map proof uses the existing exact-functor homology reflection lemma.

Use the existing comparison Hom bijection bijective_comparisonUpperStar_mapDerivedCategory_map. Lift the isomorphism comparisonNormalizationIso followed by alpha_n inverse and lift its inverse. Injectivity on Hom into bounded-below targets proves the inverse identities. The image equation gives precisely NormalizedOriginCompatibility. Cancel the retained alpha_n and use the same Hom injectivity to prove pairwise uniqueness. This is the private normalizationLift theorem.

Choose the unique lift for every pair. For equal indices apply comparison Hom injectivity and cancel alpha_n. The unit half of the comparison coherence lemma, naturality of the canonical scalar unit and rho_id make the images equal.

For k >= m >= n, apply comparison Hom injectivity with bounded-below target L_n and cancel alpha_n. Naturality of the inverse comparison mate moves the reduced beta_km across c_mn. Substitute both compatibility equations, use scalar-extension functoriality and the supplied rho_comp, and move the scalar associator past alpha_k by naturality. The composition half of the comparison coherence lemma identifies the remaining three comparison factors. This is the full quotient cocycle.
